title: DCAT Application Profile for the UK 1.2.0-rc.1
description: JSON Schema for records in the compact JSON form of DCAT-AP-UK. Pair it with the JSON-LD context to get RDF.

Dataset.title: Dataset
Dataset.description: A collection of data, published or curated by one organisation, available in one or more forms.

title.description: The name of the resource, in plain English.

description.description: A plain English account of what the resource contains and what it can be used for.

identifier.description: The main identifier of the resource in the publisher's own catalogue.

publisher.description: The organisation responsible for making the resource available.

contactPoint.description: Where to ask questions about the resource or give feedback on it.

accessRights.description: Who can get the data, and on what terms.

securityClassification.description: The classification under the Government Security Classifications Policy that the data itself carries.

licence.description: The licence under which the resource can be used.

accrualPeriodicity.description: How often the resource is updated.

criticalDataAsset.description: Whether the resource is a critical data asset under the Data Asset Management Policy.

creator.description: The organisation that created or compiled the content of the resource.

created.description: The date the content of the resource was created or compiled.

conformsTo.description: A standard, specification or schema the resource follows.

temporal.description: The period of time the data is about.

personalData.description: Whether the data contains information about identifiable living people, and in what form.

rights.description: A statement of any restriction on access or use, such as the data sharing agreement or legal gateway needed.

modified.description: The date the content of the resource last changed.

issued.description: The date the resource was first made available.

abstract.description: A one-sentence summary of the resource, of no more than 250 characters.

theme.description: The broad subject of the resource, from a controlled list.

keyword.description: Words or short phrases that people might search for, not already in the title or description.

spatial.description: The geographic area the data is about.

distribution.description: A form in which the data can be got, such as a file or an API.

landingPage.description: A web page where people can find out about the resource and how to get it.

sensitiveData.description: Whether the data contains information that needs extra care beyond being personal, such as special category data.

qualifiedAttribution.description: An organisation and the role it plays for the resource, such as data owner or data steward.

language.description: The language or languages of the resource.

alternative.description: Another name the resource is known by, such as an abbreviation or a former name.

otherIdentifier.description: Any other identifier the resource is known by, such as one in a national or sector register.

inSeries.description: The dataset series this dataset belongs to.

isReplacedBy.description: A newer resource that replaces this one.

expires.description: The date after which the resource should no longer be used.

previousVersion.description: The version this one replaces in a sequence.

spatialResolutionInMeters.description: The smallest distance the data can tell apart, in metres.

temporalResolution.description: The smallest period the data can tell apart, as an ISO 8601 duration.

referenceData.description: A code list, classification or set of groupings the data uses, such as age bands or a geography.

qualityAnnotation.description: A link to a published statement or measurement of the quality of the data.

relation.description: Another resource closely related to this one, such as the report the data supports.

qualifiedRelation.description: A related resource together with the kind of relationship.

documentation.description: A web page that documents the resource, such as a user guide or a methodology.

metadataAudience.description: Who is allowed to see the metadata record itself.

applicableLegislation.description: Legislation that requires, governs or permits the publication or sharing of the resource.

hasPolicy.description: A machine-readable policy, in the W3C Open Digital Rights Language (ODRL), saying what may and may not be done with the resource.

jurisdiction.description: Every country or territory where the data is stored or processed, or to which it is sent.

transferMechanism.description: The basis under UK GDPR on which personal data in the resource may be sent outside the UK.

missingValue.description: A property this record leaves empty on purpose, and why.

mobilityTheme.description: The kind of mobility data, such as timetables, real-time arrivals or road works, from the mobilityDCAT-AP vocabulary.

transportMode.description: The mode of transport, such as bus, rail or cycling.

networkCoverage.description: The part of the network covered, such as the strategic road network.

georeferencingMethod.description: How locations are referenced, such as coordinates or a location referencing method.

Distribution.title: Distribution
Distribution.description: A specific form of a dataset, such as a CSV file, a GeoPackage or an API response.

accessURL.description: A web address that gives access to the distribution, such as a landing page, a download page or an API.

mediaType.description: The file format, as an IANA media type.

downloadURL.description: A direct link to a file.

description.description: A plain English account of what the resource contains and what it can be used for.

licence.description: The licence under which the resource can be used.

title.description: The name of the resource, in plain English.

format.description: The file type, from the EU file type list, where there is no IANA media type.

byteSize.description: The size of the file in bytes.

checksum.description: A value that lets people check the file they downloaded is complete and unchanged.

accessService.description: A data service that gives access to this distribution.

mobilityDataStandard.description: The data standard of the file or feed, such as TransXChange, NeTEx, SIRI, GTFS or DATEX II.

DatasetSeries.description: A group of datasets published separately but sharing a subject and a method, such as each release of a census.

Catalogue.title: Catalogue
Catalogue.description: A curated collection of metadata about datasets and data services.

title.description: The name of the resource, in plain English.

description.description: A plain English account of what the resource contains and what it can be used for.

publisher.description: The organisation responsible for making the resource available.

dataset.description: A dataset listed in the catalogue.

service.description: A data service listed in the catalogue.

homepage.description: The home page of the catalogue or the organisation.

contactPoint.description: Where to ask questions about the resource or give feedback on it.

modified.description: The date the content of the resource last changed.

licence.description: The licence under which the resource can be used.

themeTaxonomy.description: The list of themes the catalogue uses to classify its records.

language.description: The language or languages of the resource.

conformsTo.description: A standard, specification or schema the resource follows.

issued.description: The date the resource was first made available.

spatial.description: The geographic area the data is about.

record.description: A record describing an entry in the catalogue.

CatalogueRecord.title: Catalogue record
CatalogueRecord.description: A record in a catalogue about one dataset or data service, with its own dates.

primaryTopic.description: The dataset or data service this record describes.

modified.description: The date the content of the resource last changed.

conformsTo.description: A standard, specification or schema the resource follows.

issued.description: The date the resource was first made available.

metadataAudience.description: Who is allowed to see the metadata record itself.

securityClassification.description: The classification under the Government Security Classifications Policy that the data itself carries.

missingValue.description: A property this record leaves empty on purpose, and why.

sourceRecord.description: The original metadata record this record was harvested or converted from.

enrichedProperty.description: A property whose value was added or changed by the harvester or converter, rather than taken from the source record.

Agent.title: Organisation
Agent.description: An organisation that publishes, creates or is responsible for a resource. In this profile, never a person.

identifier.description: The main identifier of the resource in the publisher's own catalogue.

homepage.description: The home page of the catalogue or the organisation.

agentType.description: The kind of organisation, as GOV.UK lists it, for example ministerial department or executive agency.

ContactPoint.title: Contact point
ContactPoint.description: A team that can answer questions about a resource, with the routes to reach it.

fn.description: The name of the team to contact. Never a person's name.

hasURL.description: The address of a contact form or contact page for the team.

hasEmail.description: A shared team mailbox, as a mailto address. Never a personal address.

hasAddress.description: A postal address for the team.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: A named area or a shape on the earth. Prefer the identifier of a standard area, such as a GSS code.

locationName.description: The name of the place, from a gazetteer where there is one.

bbox.description: The rectangle that contains the area, as Well-Known Text in WGS 84.

geometry.description: The exact shape of the area, as Well-Known Text.

centroid.description: The centre point of the area, as Well-Known Text.

PeriodOfTime.title: Period of time
PeriodOfTime.description: A period with a start date, an end date or both.

startDate.description: The first day the data covers.

endDate.description: The last day the data covers.

Checksum.title: Checksum
Checksum.description: A value calculated from a file, used to check it has not changed.

algorithm.description: The algorithm used to calculate the checksum, from the SPDX list.

Relationship.title: Relationship
Relationship.description: How one resource relates to another.

relation.description: Another resource closely related to this one, such as the report the data supports.

hadRole.description: The role in the relationship or attribution.

Attribution.title: Responsible role
Attribution.description: An organisation and the role it plays for a resource, such as data owner.

agent.description: The organisation that plays the role.

hadRole.description: The role in the relationship or attribution.

MissingValue.title: Missing value
MissingValue.description: A statement that one property is empty on purpose, and why, modelled on the nil reasons of GML and INSPIRE.

missingProperty.description: The property that has no value, as its prefixed name or full IRI.

missingReason.description: The reason the property has no value, from a list based on the GML and INSPIRE nil reasons.
